officialSource.officialPortalCurrentObservation: The NCERT textbook portal currently exposes the title and chapter links in its rendered Class VI shelf; the portal rendering observed during reconciliation showed twelve chapter links.
officialSource.publicationListEvidence: The NCERT publication list identifies Exploring Society: India and Beyond as Social Science Textbook for Class VI (code 0681).
officialSource.chapterCountDiscrepancy: The rendered NCERT portal shelf observed during the earlier reconciliation exposed 12 chapter links, while current 2026-27 chapter-index evidence identifies 14 chapters. The mapping therefore treats 14 as the working current textbook structure and preserves the discrepancy explicitly.

corroboratingCurrentStructure.use: Corroboration only; NCERT remains the canonical publisher/source authority.
